"""End-to-end simulation of a verifier run: 64 mixed lines."""
import json, sys, copy, random, importlib.util, base64
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/work')
import check as C
import gen as G, gen2 as G2, maxsize as MS, longpath as LP, nasty as N

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("vt", "/app/work/valid_tests.py")
vt = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); sys.argv = ["vt"]; spec.loader.exec_module(vt)

rng = random.Random(9)
lines = []       # (label, raw, request_or_None)
valid_reqs = []

def add_valid(r):
    lines.append(("valid", (json.dumps(r) + "\n").encode(), r))
    valid_reqs.append(r)

# 40 valid requests from all families
add_valid(G.gen(11)); add_valid(G2.gen(12, budget_mode="exact"))
add_valid(G2.gen(13, budget_mode="huge", tight=1.0))
add_valid(MS.gen(14))
add_valid(LP.gen(15))
r = N.symmetric(16)
for cm in r["commodities"]: cm["demand"] = 8
add_valid(r)
add_valid(N.tightbudget(17))
add_valid(N.gen("heavy", 18))
add_valid(G.gen(19)); add_valid(G.gen(20))
add_valid(G2.gen(21, budget_mode="zero"))
add_valid(G2.gen(22, budget_mode="tight"))
add_valid(copy.deepcopy(vt.BASE))
for i in range(28):
    add_valid(G.gen(100 + i))
# 24 invalid / protocol lines
inv = [c for c in vt.cases if c[1] == "bad"]
for name, expect, mutate, raw in inv[:19]:
    if raw is None:
        rr = copy.deepcopy(vt.BASE)
        mutate(rr)
        raw = (json.dumps(rr) + "\n").encode()
    if not raw.endswith(b"\n"):
        raw += b"\n"
    lines.append(("invalid:" + name, raw, None))
lines.append(("blank", b"\n", None))
lines.append(("spaces", b"   \n", None))
lines.append(("garbage", b"this is not json\n", None))
lines.append(("overlong", (json.dumps(vt.BASE).encode() + b" " * (5 * 1024 * 1024) + b"\n"), None))
assert len(lines) == 64, len(lines)
rng.shuffle(lines)

data = b"".join(raw for _lbl, raw, _r in lines)
import subprocess, time
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/planner.py'], input=data,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=900)
dt = time.time() - t0
out = p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("rc", p.returncode, "responses", len(out), "expected", len(lines), "wall %.1fs" % dt,
      "stdout %.1f KiB" % (len(p.stdout) / 1024.0), "stderr %r" % p.stderr.decode()[:200])
assert len(out) == 64, "line count mismatch"
bad = 0
nstat = {"optimal": 0, "infeasible": 0, "invalid": 0}
for (lbl, raw, req), line in zip(lines, out):
    resp = json.loads(line)
    if lbl == "valid":
        if resp.get("status") == "invalid":
            print("FAIL should be valid:", lbl); bad += 1; continue
        nstat[resp["status"]] += 1
        L = C.build(req)
        try:
            C.check_response(req, resp, L)
        except Exception as e:
            print("FAIL cert", lbl, repr(e)); bad += 1
    else:
        if resp != {"status": "invalid"}:
            print("FAIL should be invalid:", lbl, line[:120]); bad += 1
        else:
            nstat["invalid"] += 1
print("statuses", nstat, "bad", bad)
print("INTEGRATION", "PASS" if bad == 0 else "FAIL")
PYEOF
